Q: Is there a way to include different Build.props per solution? A:

Just to be precise: I assume the two solutions are in the same directory, right?

Q: Merge new WordPress design from a daf while keeping content A:

Try this: Tools->export your posts and pages from your live site.

Then import them into a staging site with your new design in place.

Then test and debug the staging site and make sure it works.

Then migrate it to production.

Take backups often. You can really slam production with this sort of import if you slip up.

Q: Variable as input in downstream pipeline not executed A:

Ah. GitLab only explicitly supports environment variables in a few places and mostly passes strings with $'s around so that they will be expanded by their destination.

In this case, when you pass an variable like this

  trigger:
    include:
      - local: "ci/sf-deploy.gitlab-ci.yml"
        inputs:
          DOCKER_IMAGE: "$DOCKER_IMAGE"
          SF_ENV: "$SF_ENV"

it passes the SF_ENV as the literal value "$SF_ENV", which is not one of the allowed values.

I have not found a particularly elegant way around this, except to pass such values as variables the old way.
